name: gcc
description: GNU Compiler Collection, rebuilt with explicit POSIX thread support for musl (fixes missing std::call_once / std::__once_call symbols in libstdc++).
build: cd gcc-build && export gcc_cv_have_tls=yes glibcxx_cv_have_tls=yes MAKEINFO=missing && ../gcc-15.3.0/configure --prefix="$PREFIX" --build=x86_64-pc-linux-musl --host=x86_64-pc-linux-musl --target=x86_64-pc-linux-musl --enable-languages=c,c++ --enable-threads=posix --enable-tls --disable-multilib --disable-bootstrap --disable-nls --disable-werror --disable-libsanitizer --disable-libmpx --disable-libcilkrts --disable-libitm --with-system-zlib=no
install: for f in libstdc++.a libstdc++.so libstdc++.so.6 libstdc++.so.6.0.34 libgcc_s.so libgcc_s.so.1; do src=""; for d in "$DESTDIR/usr/lib64" "$DESTDIR/usr/x86_64-pc-linux-musl/lib64" "$DESTDIR/usr/lib"; do if [ -f "$d/$f" ] && [ ! -L "$d/$f" ]; then src="$d/$f"; fi; done; if [ -n "$src" ]; then for d in "$DESTDIR/usr/lib64" "$DESTDIR/usr/x86_64-pc-linux-musl/lib64" "$DESTDIR/usr/lib"; do if [ -e "$d/$f" ] || [ -d "$d" ]; then cp -f "$src" "$d/$f"; fi; done; fi; done
